contrast-on-gradient.detail: contrast is not one number across this text: it varies horizontally, 6.15:1 at the left and 1.73:1 at the right. Any single computed value is a fiction, and the right end is the one that fails a reader

optical-centering.detail: div.glyph-btn:nth-of-type(2) centres this mark exactly, but its rendered ink sits 4.2px left and 3.0px up of the container's painted centre, and nothing compensates for it -- it will read as misaligned however correct the CSS is
